name: MSM
recent: MSM 与 Ranhill 的诉讼在和解谈判失败后将进入审讯，公司自 9 月以来多次发布重大诉讼公告。Prai 炼糖厂将以 15 年租约继续运营。最新季度营收环比增长 9.9%，但同比减少 25.2%，净利润率回升至 3.9%。
notable: 公司与 Ranhill 的诉讼在和解谈判失败后将进入审讯。
Prai 炼糖厂将以 15 年租约继续运营。
公司首席执行官配偶在闭市期外间接增持 209,000 股。
risks: 公司与 Ranhill 的诉讼进入审讯阶段。
公司自 9 月以来多次发布重大诉讼公告。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为 MYR 607.8 million，环比增长 9.9%，同比减少 25.2%；净利润为 MYR 23.4 million，净利润率 3.9%，较上一季度的 -3.4% 回升。

recent_en: MSM's litigation with Ranhill will proceed to trial after settlement talks failed, with multiple material litigation announcements since September. The Prai sugar refinery will continue operating under a 15-year lease. Latest quarter revenue rose 9.9% QoQ but fell 25.2% YoY, with net margin recovering to 3.9%.
notable_en: The litigation with Ranhill will proceed to trial after settlement talks failed.
The Prai sugar refinery will continue operating under a 15-year lease.
The Group CEO's spouse indirectly acquired 209,000 shares outside a closed period.
risks_en: The litigation with Ranhill is proceeding to trial.
The company has issued multiple material litigation announcements since September.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 607.8 million, up 9.9% QoQ but down 25.2% YoY; net income was MYR 23.4 million with a net margin of 3.9%, recovering from -3.4% in the previous quarter.
